svg.title: k3s-gitops-lab infrastructure
svg.desc: Architecture of the k3s-gitops-lab project: a GitHub repository whose protected main branch drives a single-node K3s cluster on one EC2 instance in AWS eu-central-1, reached publicly only on HTTPS through DuckDNS and Traefik and administratively only over a Tailscale tailnet, with a push path (GitHub Actions joins the tailnet and applies namespace push) and a pull path (Argo CD polls main and syncs namespace gitops), Alloy shipping metrics and logs to Grafana Cloud, and a weekly rebuild from git.
svg.text: GITHUB · sabocalin/k3s-gitops-lab · ENVIRONMENTS production + lab (main only)
AWS ACCOUNT · eu-central-1 · NO STATIC KEYS
VPC 10.42.0.0/16 · 3 PUBLIC /24 SUBNETS · IGW · NO NAT GATEWAY
EC2 t4g.medium · UBUNTU 24.04 arm64 · SG INBOUND 80/443 ONLY · IMDSv2 HOP 1
K3s v1.37.1 single node · pods 10.52.0.0/16 · services 10.53.0.0/16 · Secrets encrypted at rest · CoreDNS → 169.254.169.253

g.text: A → node IP, set at boot
cordon · one node at a time
pod logs via the K8s API

svg.text: Focal: source of truth, API gate
